selection_basis: Development OOF calibration, original-dollar errors, fold stability, tail sensitivity, and GPD parameter uncertainty; conventional Gamma retained after body/tail comparison

frequency.preprocessing: Raw numerical predictors; VehGas and Region converted to pandas categorical with recorded levels
frequency.prediction: Annual claim frequency; multiply by Exposure for expected policy claim count

severity.formula: ClaimAmount ~ np.log(DrivAge) + np.log(BonusMalus) + np.log1p(VehAge) + VehPower + C(VehGas) + np.log(Density) + C(Region)

fit.start_params: Intercept = log(mean fitting ClaimAmount); all other coefficients = 0

severity.target: Original ClaimAmount for every development claim; no capping or exclusions

next_step: Notebook 07: refit the frozen specifications on all development data, then evaluate once on the reserved test set

lognormal_benchmark.formula: np.log(ClaimAmount) ~ np.log(DrivAge) + np.log(BonusMalus) + np.log1p(VehAge) + VehPower + C(VehGas) + np.log(Density) + C(Region)
lognormal_benchmark.fit: Ordinary least squares on log(ClaimAmount), same predictors as Gamma
lognormal_benchmark.normal_retransformation: exp(predicted log amount + sigma_squared / 2); sigma_squared = mean squared fitting residual
lognormal_benchmark.correction_estimated_from: Fitting portion of each policy-level CV fold only

body_tail_comparison.body: Upper-truncated Gamma; log parent mean; common shape
body_tail_comparison.probability: Logistic exceedance probability on all fitting claims, no exposure offset or class balancing
body_tail_comparison.tail: GPD excess, location zero, constant scale and unrestricted constant shape
body_tail_comparison.reason_not_selected: 20,000-threshold aggregate calibration is competitive, but expected means remain threshold-sensitive and less stable across folds; GPD uncertainty includes nonfinite means; predictor additions yield little reproducible gain
